name: Ricardo Vargas
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing himself, but by dissecting the engineering behind it. Growing up in Lima, he devoured books on aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics, translating theoretical knowledge into practical modifications for local racing teams. His sharp eye for detail and ability to identify performance bottlenecks quickly made him indispensable.

Ricardo joined Sprint V8 Team five years ago as a data analyst, rapidly climbing the ranks due to his innovative strategies and talent for team management. As Sporting Director, he emphasizes a holistic approach, believing that a well-coordinated team, driven by clear data analysis and bold strategies, is the key to victory. He is known for his meticulous preparation and ability to anticipate competitors' moves, often turning seemingly impossible situations into opportunities.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on the left side.
physical.description: Ricardo has a focused gaze and a confident posture that commands respect.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down ideas at any given moment.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific type of Peruvian coffee before every race.
